title: Outreach to Akropong School for the Blind
venue: Akropong School for the Blind, Akropong, Eastern Region
summary: Our Evangelism Ministry visits the Akropong School for the Blind to share the love of Christ. Volunteers and donations welcome.
description: Join the Evangelism Ministry as we visit the Akropong School for the Blind to share the gospel, pray with the students and staff, and give practical support.
To volunteer or donate, please contact the church office or give through the Give page, using Evangelism as your reference.

title: Children's Week Celebration
summary: A week of celebrating our children, with activities led by the Children's Ministry.
description: From 14 to 20 December, ECM sets aside a full week to celebrate our children and thank God for them.
Parents, families and friends are warmly invited to join the Children's Ministry for this special week.

title: Children's Day Celebration
summary: A special service where our children led worship, sang and celebrated God's goodness with the whole church.
description: On Sunday 21 September 2025, ECM celebrated Children's Day with a special service led by the Children's Ministry.
Our children sang, danced and worshipped, and the whole church thanked God for them. Watch the service below.
